products.name: Voiceflow
products.note: Conversational AI design; voice/chat agent builder; enterprise team features

profile_text.body:
Voiceflow is a software company that describes itself as an enterprise conversational AI platform designed to help teams build, launch, and scale chat and voice AI agents, with a primary focus on customer support and customer experience applications. The platform is aimed at enterprise users and emphasizes the ability to experiment with and orchestrate generative conversational architectures.

The company's core product, also called Voiceflow, is categorized as a coding and developer tool and covers conversational AI design, voice and chat agent building, and enterprise team features. A user quoted on the company's site, Andre Fredericks, describes the platform as providing significant acceleration and enabling teams to focus on orchestration and building generative conversational systems rather than lower-level tasks.

The held facts confirm Voiceflow maintains an active profile on theworldofai.org and list no litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations at this time.
